Subject: Request: open req for Senior Inference Engineer (Serving Runtime)

Neha / Priyom —

We need to open a req for a Senior Inference Engineer on the Serving Runtime team to replace an upcoming backfill and to cover the new model-ops workstream. Key justification: sustained throughput projects + work on kernel selection and quantization pipelines. Hiring manager is me; the role will be IC3/IC4 depending on slate.

Asks:
- Quick approval to post the req (we're seeing candidate interest this quarter).
- Alignment on interview panel (I propose: Laura (hiring mgr), Markus (runtime architecture), Neha (platform), Priyom (recruiting).)
- Request for recruiter to reach out to a warm candidate Emily Ramirez (referral) — resume attached.

I've attached the latest JD and a proposed interview rubric; budget note pending Priyom's sign-off.

Thanks,
Laura
